title: Client side form validation with clear errors
when: A form must check fields before submit and show helpful, accessible errors (sign up, checkout, contact, settings).
prompt:
Goal: Native constraints plus custom rules, errors next to fields and in a summary, announced to screen readers. Steps: 1. Declare what HTML can: required, type="email", minlength, maxlength, min, max, pattern, autocomplete; add novalidate to render custom messages. 2. On submit run form.checkValidity(); map each field.validity flag (valueMissing, typeMismatch, tooShort, patternMismatch) to a human message. 3. Cross field rules (passwords match, end after start) use setCustomValidity(msg), cleared with setCustomValidity(""). 4. Show each error in

linked by aria-describedby and set aria-invalid="true". 5. Failed submit: an error summary with role="alert" at the top, links to each field, focus moved to it, submission stopped. 6. Validate on blur after the first attempt and on input once a field is invalid, never on the first keystroke. Quality bar: - Messages say how to fix it ("Use at least 8 characters"). - Typed values are never cleared on error. - The server repeats the checks. Pitfalls: - Errors shown only as red borders. - A disabled submit button that never explains why. - Email regex so strict real addresses fail. Verify: - [ ] Every field labeled; errors linked by aria-describedby. - [ ] aria-invalid toggles. - [ ] Summary gets focus on failure. - [ ] The form has a submit button. Output: Form markup with constraints and js/validate-form.js with the message map and handlers.

examples.input: validar o formulário de cadastro antes de enviar
examples.output: novalidate form, messages from validity flags, password match via setCustomValidity, role=alert summary
